articles.title: Wyoming joins $15 billion LayerZero exodus with state stablecoin move
articles.description: This is the first time a U.S. government entity has publicly replaced its blockchain infrastructure specifically on security grounds.

articles.title: OpenAI institutes new safeguards after Hugging Face breach
articles.description: The new safeguards include more detailed monitoring of models during the development process, as well as greater emphasis on alignment and security during the post-training process.

articles.title: Kraken’s Krak debuts US debit card as Payward broadens financial services push
articles.description: The multi-asset card lets US customers spend crypto and fiat and earn cashback as Kraken’s parent company expands across financial services.

articles.title: Save up to $300 on your TechCrunch Disrupt 2026 pass until August 21
articles.description: If you’ve been circling around Disrupt, then now’s the best time to lock in your pass and start getting ready to join the rest of the startup community gathering in San Francisco from October 13-15 at Moscone West!

articles.title: Etched’s valuation doubles to $21B in a month
articles.description: Jane Street has installed Etched's first shipped AI cluster system, and was so impressed, it led another massive round, the startup says.

articles.title: Apple overhauls its EU App Store fees, loosens rules for alternative app stores
articles.description: Apple is simplifying its EU App Store fees, replacing its per-install fee with a 5% commission for apps distributed outside the App Store and making it easier for developers to operate alternative app marketplaces.

articles.title: Bitcoin has gone quiet as traders chase ‘5x or 10x’ payoffs elsewhere
articles.description: Bitcoin's price swings have hit a cycle low, squeezed by a market tug-of-war with no clear winner. The traders who once lived off its chaos have taken their risk appetite elsewhere.

articles.title: Federal prosecutors blast ex-Celsius CEO’s motion to vacate as ‘without merit’
articles.description: Despite already serving a 12-year sentence in federal prison, Alex Mashinsky continues to explore legal avenues to vacate his conviction related to activities at Celsius.

articles.title: Metaplanet expands Bitcoin treasury strategy to US with 2,100-BTC Nasdaq play
articles.description: The proposed deal with Nasdaq-listed Super League Enterprise would give the Tokyo-based company a foothold in US capital markets while using existing Bitcoin rather than additional purchases.

articles.title: Why Apple’s camera-equipped AirPods may not be the ‘pervert pods’ consumers fear
articles.description: Apple’s leaked camera-equipped AirPods might avoid the privacy pitfalls of other AI wearables by preventing users from recording photos and videos.

articles.title: Kraken adds U.S. stocks in Europe as TradFi-crypto divide blurs
articles.description: The exchange said it is the first crypto company to offer European customers both traditional U.S. equities and tokenized versions of those assets on a single regulated platform.

articles.title: Neuberger teams with Securitize on multi-chain tokenized fixed-income fund launch
articles.description: The $613 billion asset manager will subadvise a high-yield fund tokenized across Ethereum, Solana, Avalanche and Sui.

articles.title: Bitcoin tags $65K as S&P 500 rebounds from 2-week lows on US-Iran rhetoric
articles.description: Bitcoin returned to $65,000 for the first time in a week as fresh BTC price volatility accompanied US claims that the Strait of Hormuz was “open and operating.”

articles.title: Peacock is raising prices across all of its streaming plans
articles.description: "These price changes allow Peacock to continue to create the best experience for its viewers, remain competitive in the marketplace, and deliver unique content across all genres," the company wrote on a support page.

articles.title: Why the Trump-backed crypto venture is distancing itself from Hong Kong AI aggregator WorldClaw
articles.description: WLFI says the AI platform is independent and uses USD1 as a payment rail, but would not say whether it has equity, financing, revenue-sharing or other economic interests in the company.

articles.title: Bitcoin miners’ AI pivot pays off, but mining could revive with one twist
articles.description: Miners with AI and high-performance computing contracts have commanded higher valuations as declining bitcoin prices and hashprice squeeze pure-play operators.

articles.title: Global bond yields surge as debt fears test bitcoin’s hedge narrative
articles.description: Long-term borrowing costs are reaching multi-decade highs as U.S. debt approaches $40 trillion and AI hyperscalers accelerate bond issuance.

articles.title: Japan's Metaplanet launching U.S. bitcoin treasury company through $135 million nanocap deal
articles.description: The deal involves Metaplanet contributing 2,100 bitcoin and $2.5 million in cash, valuing the initial investment at $134.6 million.

articles.title: HashKey taps Hong Kong's first regulated stablecoin to settle insurance and trade deals
articles.description: Following institutional trials, the HKD-pegged asset is being put to work to capture part of Hong Kong's $49 billion trade corridor with the United Arab Emirates

articles.title: Anthro Energy breaks ground on factory that could pave the road to solid-state batteries
articles.description: Battery materials startup Anthro Energy has broken ground on a Louisville factory to make electrolytes, including those for solid-state batteries.
